From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Export mutil.

From cgraphs.cgraphs Require Export util.

Definition session := nat.

Definition participant := nat.

Definition endpoint := (session * participant)%type.

Inductive val :=
  | UnitV : val
  | NatV : nat -> val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | InjV : bool -> val -> val
  | InjNV : nat -> val -> val
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UFunV : string -> expr -> val
  | ChanV : endpoint -> (participant -> participant) -> val

with expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Inj : bool -> expr -> expr
  | InjN : nat -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | UApp : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Lam : string -> expr -> expr
  | ULam : string -> expr -> expr
  | Send : participant -> expr -> nat -> expr -> expr
  | Recv : participant -> expr -> expr
  | Let : string -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetUnit : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetProd : string -> string -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | MatchVoid : expr -> expr
  | MatchSum : expr -> string -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSumN n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | If : expr -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | Spawn n : (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | Close : expr -> expr
  | Relabel : (participant -> participant) -> expr -> expr.

Fixpoint subst (x:string) (a:val) (e:expr) : expr :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => e
  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | App e1 e2 => App (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | Inj b e1 => Inj b (subst x a e1)
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | UApp e1 e2 => UApp (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | Lam x' e1 => if decide (x = x') then e else Lam x' (subst x a e1)
  | ULam x' e1 => if decide (x = x') then e else ULam x' (subst x a e1)
  | Send p e1 i e2 => Send p (subst x a e1) i (subst x a e2)
  | Recv p e1 => Recv p (subst x a e1)
  | Let x' e1 e2 => Let x' (subst x a e1) (if decide (x = x') then e2 else subst x a e2)
  | LetUnit e1 e2 => LetUnit (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | LetProd x' y' e1 e2 =>
    LetProd x' y' (subst x a e1) (if decide (x = x' ∨ x = y') then e2 else subst x a e2)
  | MatchVoid e1 => MatchVoid (subst x a e1)
  | MatchSum e1 x' eL eR =>
    MatchSum (subst x a e1) x'
    (if decide (x = x') then eL else subst x a eL)
    (if decide (x = x') then eR else subst x a eR)
  | InjN n e => InjN n (subst x a e)
  | MatchSumN n e f => MatchSumN n (subst x a e) (λ i, subst x a (f i))
  | If e1 e2 e3 => If (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2) (subst x a e3)
  | Spawn ps f => Spawn ps (λ p, subst x a (f p))
  | Close e1 => Close (subst x a e1)
  | Relabel π e1 => Relabel π (subst x a e1)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Pair_step : ∀ v1 v2,
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val (PairV v1 v2))
  | Inj_step : ∀ v1 b,
    pure_step (Inj b (Val v1)) (Val (InjV b v1))
  | App_step : ∀ x e a,
    pure_step (App (Val (FunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | UApp_step : ∀ x e a,
    pure_step (UApp (Val (UFunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Lam_step : ∀ x e,
    pure_step (Lam x e) (Val (FunV x e))
  | ULam_step : ∀ x e,
    pure_step (ULam x e) (Val (UFunV x e))
  | If_step1 : ∀ n e1 e2,
    n ≠ 0 ->
    pure_step (If (Val (NatV n)) e1 e2) e1
  | If_step2 : ∀ e1 e2,
    pure_step (If (Val (NatV 0)) e1 e2) e2
  | MatchSum_step : ∀ x v eL eR b,
    pure_step (MatchSum (Val (InjV b v)) x eL eR)
      (if b then subst x v eL else subst x v eR)
  | InjN_step : ∀ n v,
    pure_step (InjN n (Val v)) (Val (InjNV n v))
  | MatchSumN_step : ∀ n i v f,
    pure_step (MatchSumN n (Val (InjNV (fin_to_nat i) v)) f) (App (f i) (Val v))
  | Let_step : ∀ x v e,
    pure_step (Let x (Val v) e) (subst x v e)
  | LetUnit_step : ∀ e,
    pure_step (LetUnit (Val UnitV) e) e
  | LetProd_step : ∀ x1 x2 v1 v2 e,
    pure_step (LetProd x1 x2 (Val (PairV v1 v2)) e) (subst x1 v1 $ subst x2 v2 e)
  | Relabel_step : ∀ π1 π2 c p,
    pure_step (Relabel π1 (Val (ChanV (c,p) π2))) (Val (ChanV (c,p) (π2 ∘ π1))).

Definition entryT := (nat * val)%type.

Notation bufsT A B V := (gmap B (gmap A (list V))).

Definition heap := bufsT participant endpoint entryT.

Definition push `{Countable A, Countable B} {V} (p : A) (q : B) (x : V) (bufss : bufsT A B V) : bufsT A B V :=
  alter (alter (λ buf, buf ++ [x]) p) q bufss.

Definition pop `{Countable A, Countable B} {V} (p : A) (q : B) (bufss : bufsT A B V) : option (V * bufsT A B V) :=
  match bufss !! q with
  | Some bufs =>
    match bufs !! p with
    | Some (v :: buf) => Some (v, <[ q := <[ p := buf ]> bufs ]> bufss)
    | _ => None
    end
  | None => None
  end.

Definition init_chans {A} n : bufsT participant participant A :=
  fin_gmap n (λ i, fin_gmap n (λ j, [])).

Definition init_threads (c : session) (n : nat) (fv : fin n -> val) : list expr :=
  fin_list n (λ i, App (Val (fv i)) (Val (ChanV (c, S (fin_to_nat i)) id))).

Inductive head_step : expr -> heap -> expr -> heap -> list expr -> Prop :=
  | Pure_step : ∀ e e' h,
    pure_step e e' -> head_step e h e' h []
  | Send_step : ∀ h c p q y i π,


    head_step (Send q (Val (ChanV (c,p) π)) i (Val y)) h
          (Val (ChanV (c,p) π))
          (push p (c,π q) (i,y) h)
          []
  | Recv_step : ∀ h c p q i y h' π,
    pop (π p) (c,q) h = Some ((i,y), h') ->
    head_step (Recv p (Val (ChanV (c,q) π))) h
          (Val (InjNV i (PairV (ChanV (c,q) π) y)))
          h'
          []
  | Close_step : ∀ c p h π,
    head_step (Close (Val (ChanV (c,p) π))) h
          (Val UnitV)
          (delete (c,p) h)
          []
  | Spawn_step : ∀ (h : heap) c n f fv,
    (∀ p, h !! (c,p) = None) ->
    (∀ p, f p = Val (fv p)) ->
    head_step
      (Spawn n f) h
      (Val (ChanV (c, 0) id))
      (gmap_unslice (init_chans (S n)) c ∪ h)
      (init_threads c n fv).

Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_App_l e : ctx1 (λ x, App x e)
  | Ctx_App_r v : ctx1 (λ x, App (Val v) x)
  | Ctx_Pair_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair x e)
  | Ctx_Pair_r v : ctx1 (λ x, Pair (Val v) x)
  | Ctx_Inj b : ctx1 (λ x, Inj b x)
  | Ctx_UApp_l e : ctx1 (λ x, UApp x e)
  | Ctx_UApp_r v : ctx1 (λ x, UApp (Val v) x)
  | Ctx_Send_l p e i : ctx1 (λ x, Send p x i e)
  | Ctx_Send_r p v i : ctx1 (λ x, Send p (Val v) i x)
  | Ctx_Recv p : ctx1 (λ x, Recv p x)
  | Ctx_Let s e : ctx1 (λ x, Let s x e)
  | Ctx_LetUnit e : ctx1 (λ x, LetUnit x e)
  | Ctx_LetProd s1 s2 e : ctx1 (λ x, LetProd s1 s2 x e)
  | Ctx_MatchVoid : ctx1 (λ x, MatchVoid x)
  | Ctx_MatchSum s e1 e2 : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSum x s e1 e2)
  | Ctx_InjN i : ctx1 (λ x, InjN i x)
  | Ctx_MatchSumN n f : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSumN n x f)
  | Ctx_If e1 e2 : ctx1 (λ x, If x e1 e2)
  | Ctx_Spawn n (f : fin n -> expr) (p : fin n) :
    ctx1 (λ x, Spawn n (λ q, if decide (p = q) then x else f q))
  | Ctx_Close : ctx1 (λ x, Close x)
  | Ctx_Relabel π : ctx1 (λ x, Relabel π x).

Inductive ctx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_nil : ctx (λ x, x)
  | Ctx_cons : ∀ k1 k2, ctx1 k1 -> ctx k2 -> ctx (λ x, (k1 (k2 x))).

Inductive ctx_step : expr -> heap -> expr -> heap -> list expr -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_step : ∀ k e h e' h' ts,
    ctx k -> head_step e h e' h' ts -> ctx_step (k e) h (k e') h' ts.

Inductive stepi : nat -> list expr -> heap -> list expr -> heap -> Prop :=
  | Head_step : ∀ e e' h h' i ts es,
    ctx_step e h e' h' ts ->
    es !! i = Some e ->
    stepi i es h (<[i := e']> es ++ ts) h'.

Definition can_stepi i es h := ∃ es' h', stepi i es h es' h'.

Definition step es h es' h' := ∃ i, stepi i es h es' h'.

Inductive steps : list expr -> heap -> list expr -> heap -> Prop :=
  | Trans_step : ∀ e1 e2 e3 s1 s2 s3,
    step e1 s1 e2 s2 ->
    steps e2 s2 e3 s3 ->
    steps e1 s1 e3 s3
  | Empty_step : ∀ e1 s1,
    steps e1 s1 e1 s1.

CoInductive session_type' (T : Type) :=
  | SendT n : participant -> (fin n -> T) -> (fin n -> session_type' T) -> session_type' T
  | RecvT n : participant -> (fin n -> T) -> (fin n -> session_type' T) -> session_type' T
  | EndT : session_type' T.

Arguments SendT {_} _ _ _.

Arguments RecvT {_} _ _ _.

Arguments EndT {_}.

Global Instance finvec_equiv `{Equiv T} n : Equiv (fin n -> T) := λ f g, ∀ i, f i ≡ g i.

CoInductive session_type_equiv `{Equiv T} : Equiv (session_type' T) :=
  | cteq_EndT : EndT ≡ EndT
  | cteq_SendT n t1 t2 f1 f2 p : t1 ≡ t2 -> f1 ≡ f2 -> SendT n p t1 f1 ≡ SendT n p t2 f2
  | cteq_RecvT n t1 t2 f1 f2 p : t1 ≡ t2 -> f1 ≡ f2 -> RecvT n p t1 f1 ≡ RecvT n p t2 f2.

Global Existing Instance session_type_equiv.

Definition session_type_id {T} (s : session_type' T) : session_type' T :=
  match s with
  | SendT n p t s' => SendT n p t s'
  | RecvT n p t s' => RecvT n p t s'
  | EndT => EndT
  end.

CoInductive type :=
  | UnitT : type
  | VoidT : type
  | NatT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT : type -> type -> type
  | SumNT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
  | FunT : type -> type -> type
  | UFunT : type -> type -> type
  | ChanT : session_type' type -> type.

Definition type_id (t : type) :=
  match t with
  | UnitT => UnitT
  | VoidT => VoidT
  | NatT => NatT
  | PairT t1 t2 => PairT t1 t2
  | SumT t1 t2 => SumT t1 t2
  | SumNT n f => SumNT n f
  | FunT t1 t2 => FunT t1 t2
  | UFunT t1 t2 => UFunT t1 t2
  | ChanT s => ChanT s
  end.

CoInductive type_equiv : Equiv type :=
  | teq_UnitT : UnitT ≡ UnitT
  | teq_VoidT : VoidT ≡ VoidT
  | teq_NatT : NatT ≡ NatT
  | teq_PairT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> PairT t1 t1' ≡ PairT t2 t2'
  | teq_SumT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> SumT t1 t1' ≡ SumT t2 t2'
  | teq_SumNT n f1 f2 : f1 ≡ f2 -> SumNT n f1 ≡ SumNT n f2
  | teq_FunT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> FunT t1 t1' ≡ FunT t2 t2'
  | teq_UFunT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> UFunT t1 t1' ≡ UFunT t2 t2'
  | teq_ChanT s1 s2 : s1 ≡ s2 -> ChanT s1 ≡ ChanT s2.

Global Existing Instance type_equiv.

Notation session_type := (session_type' type).

CoFixpoint relabelT (π : participant -> participant) (σ : session_type) :=
  match σ with
  | SendT n p ts σs => SendT n (π p) ts (relabelT π ∘ σs)
  | RecvT n p ts σs => RecvT n (π p) ts (relabelT π ∘ σs)
  | EndT => EndT
  end.

Notation envT := (gmap string type).

CoInductive unrestricted : type -> Prop :=
  | Nat_unrestricted : unrestricted NatT
  | Unit_unrestricted : unrestricted UnitT
  | Void_unrestricted : unrestricted VoidT
  | UFun_unrestricted t1 t2 : unrestricted (UFunT t1 t2)
  | Pair_unrestricted t1 t2 :
    unrestricted t1 -> unrestricted t2 ->
    unrestricted (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unrestricted t1 t2 :
    unrestricted t1 -> unrestricted t2 ->
    unrestricted (SumT t1 t2)
  | SumN_unrestricted n f :
    (∀ i, unrestricted (f i)) -> unrestricted (SumNT n f).

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : envT) : Prop :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 ≡ t2 ∧ unrestricted t1.

Definition Γunrestricted (Γ : envT) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unrestricted t.

Record disj_union n (Γ : envT) (fΓ : fin n -> envT) : Prop := {
  du_disj p q : p ≠ q -> disj (fΓ p) (fΓ q);
  du_left p x t : (fΓ p) !! x ≡ Some t -> Γ !! x ≡ Some t;
  du_right x t : Γ !! x ≡ Some t -> ∃ p, (fΓ p) !! x ≡ Some t
}.

Definition sentryT := (nat * type)%type.

Definition sbufsT := bufsT participant participant sentryT.

Definition can_progress {A}
  (bufs : bufsT participant participant A)
  (σs : gmap participant session_type) := ∃ q σ,
    σs !! q = Some σ ∧
    match σ with
    | RecvT n p _ _ => ∃ y bufs', pop p q bufs = Some(y,bufs')
    | _ => True
    end.

Definition buf_empty (bufs : bufsT participant participant sentryT) (p : participant) :=
  ∀ bs, bufs !! p = Some bs ->
    ∀ q buf, bs !! q = Some buf -> buf = [].

Definition bufs_empty {A} (bufs : bufsT participant participant A) :=
  ∀ p q, pop p q bufs = None.

Definition is_present `{Countable A, Countable B} {V}
    p q (bufss : bufsT A B V) :=
  match bufss !! q with
  | Some bufs => match bufs !! p with Some _ => True | None => False end
  | None => False
  end.

CoInductive sbufs_typed
  (bufs : bufsT participant participant sentryT)
  (σs : gmap participant session_type) : Prop := {




  sbufs_typed_send
      (n : nat) (p q : participant) ts ss (i : fin n) :
    σs !! p = Some (SendT n q ts ss) ->
      is_present p q bufs ∧
      sbufs_typed (push p q (fin_to_nat i,ts i) bufs) (<[p:=ss i]> σs);




  sbufs_typed_recv
      (bufs' : bufsT participant participant sentryT)
      (n : nat) (p q : participant) t i ts ss :
    σs !! q = Some (RecvT n p ts ss) ->
    pop p q bufs = Some((i,t),bufs') ->
    ∃ i', i = fin_to_nat i' ∧ t = ts i' ∧
      sbufs_typed bufs' (<[ q := ss i' ]> σs);




  sbufs_typed_end p :
    σs !! p = Some EndT ->
      buf_empty bufs p ∧
      sbufs_typed (delete p bufs) (delete p σs);


  sbufs_typed_progress :
    bufs = ∅ ∨ can_progress bufs σs;


  sbufs_typed_dom :
    dom bufs = dom σs
}.

Definition consistent n (σs : fin n -> session_type) :=
  sbufs_typed (init_chans n) (fin_gmap n σs).

Inductive typed : envT -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    typed Γ (Val UnitV) UnitT
  | Nat_typed : ∀ Γ n,
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    typed Γ (Val (NatV n)) NatT
  | Var_typed : ∀ Γ x t t',
    Γ !! x = None ->
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    t ≡ t' ->
    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t ]}) (Var x) t'
  | Pair_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | App_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (App e1 e2) t2
  | UApp_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (UFunT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (UApp e1 e2) t2
  | Lam_typed : ∀ Γ x e t1 t2,
    Γ !! x = None ->
    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Lam x e) (FunT t1 t2)
  | ULam_typed : ∀ Γ x e t1 t2,
    Γ !! x = None ->
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e t2 ->
    typed Γ (ULam x e) (UFunT t1 t2)
  | Send_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 n t r p i,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (ChanT (SendT n p t r)) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (t i) ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Send p e1 (fin_to_nat i) e2) (ChanT (r i))
  | Recv_typed : ∀ Γ e n t r p,
    typed Γ e (ChanT (RecvT n p t r)) ->
    typed Γ (Recv p e) (SumNT n (λ i, PairT (ChanT (r i)) (t i)))
  | Let_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 x,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    Γ2 !! x = None ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e2 t2 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Let x e1 e2) t2
  | LetUnit_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 UnitT ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (LetUnit e1 e2) t
  | LetProd_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t11 t12 t2 x1 x2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    x1 ≠ x2 ->
    Γ2 !! x1 = None ->
    Γ2 !! x2 = None ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t11 t12) ->
    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x1 := t11 ]} ∪ {[ x2 := t12 ]}) e2 t2 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (LetProd x1 x2 e1 e2) t2
  | MatchVoid_typed : ∀ Γ e t,

From stdpp Require Export gmap.

Require Export cgraphs.multiparty.langdef.

Inductive object := Thread (_:nat) | Chan (_:session).

Definition object_code (x : object) : (nat + nat)%type :=
  match x with Thread n => inl n | Chan n => inr n end.

Definition object_decode (c : (nat + nat)%type) : object :=
  match c with inl n => Thread n | inr n => Chan n end.

Definition object_roundtrip (x : object) : object_decode (object_code x) = x :=
  match x with Thread _ => eq_refl | Chan _ => eq_refl end.

#[export] Instance object_eqdecision : EqDecision object :=
  fun x y =>
    match decide (object_code x = object_code y) with
    | left h =>
        left (eq_trans (eq_sym (object_roundtrip x))
          (eq_trans (f_equal object_decode h) (object_roundtrip y)))
    | right h => right (fun p => h (f_equal object_code p))
    end.

#[export] Instance object_countable : Countable object :=
  inj_countable' object_code object_decode object_roundtrip.

Fixpoint expr_refs (e : expr) : gset object :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_refs v
  | Var x => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Inj b e1 => expr_refs e1
  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | UApp e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Lam s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | ULam s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | Send p e1 i e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Recv p e1 => expr_refs e1
  | Let s e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetUnit e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetProd s1 s2 e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | MatchVoid e1 => expr_refs e1
  | MatchSum e1 s e2 e3 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2 ∪ expr_refs e3
  | InjN i e => expr_refs e
  | MatchSumN n e f => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ f)
  | If e1 e2 e3 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Spawn n f => fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ f)
  | Close e1 => expr_refs e1
  | Relabel π e1 => expr_refs e1
  end
with val_refs (v : val) : gset object :=
  match v with
  | UnitV => ∅
  | NatV n => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_refs v1 ∪ val_refs v2
  | InjV b v1 => val_refs v1
  | InjNV i v1 => val_refs v1
  | FunV s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | UFunV s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | ChanV (c,b) _ => {[ Chan c ]}
  end.

Definition map_union `{Countable K, Countable A} {V} (f : V -> gset A) (m : gmap K V) :=
  map_fold (λ k v s, f v ∪ s) ∅ m.

Definition buf_refs (buf : list entryT) := foldr (λ '(i,v) s, val_refs v ∪ s) ∅ buf.

Definition bufs_refs (bufss : bufsT participant participant entryT) : gset object :=
  map_union (map_union buf_refs) bufss.

Definition obj_refs (es : list expr) (h : heap) (x : object) : gset object :=
  match x with
  | Thread n => from_option expr_refs ∅ (es !! n)
  | Chan c => bufs_refs (gmap_slice h c)
  end.

Definition thread_blocked (es : list expr) (h : heap) (i c : nat) :=
  ∃ p q k π, ctx k ∧
    es !! i = Some (k (Recv p (Val (ChanV (c,q) π)))) ∧
    is_Some (h !! (c,q)) ∧
    pop (π p) (c,q) h = None.

Definition active (es : list expr) (h : heap) (x : object) :=
  match x with
  | Thread i => ∃ e, es !! i = Some e ∧ e ≠ Val UnitV
  | Chan i => ∃ p, is_Some (h !! (i,p))
  end.

Record deadlock (es : list expr) (h : heap) (s : gset object) := {
  dl_nonempty : s ≠ ∅;
  dl_active x : x ∈ s -> active es h x;
  dl_threadb i : Thread i ∈ s -> ¬ can_stepi i es h;
  dl_threadw i c : Thread i ∈ s -> thread_blocked es h i c -> Chan c ∈ s;
  dl_chan c x : Chan c ∈ s -> Chan c ∈ obj_refs es h x -> x ∈ s
}.

Definition deadlock_free es h := ∀ s, ¬ deadlock es h s.

Inductive reachable (es : list expr) (h : heap) : object → Prop :=
  | Thread_step_reachable i : can_stepi i es h → reachable es h (Thread i)
  | Thread_blocked_reachable i c : reachable es h (Chan c) → thread_blocked es h i c → reachable es h (Thread i)
  | Chan_ref_reachable c x : (Chan c) ∈ obj_refs es h x → reachable es h x → reachable es h (Chan c).

Definition fully_reachable es h := ∀ x, active es h x -> reachable es h x.

From stdpp Require Export finite.

Fixpoint insert2 {T} (i : nat) (x : T) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  match i,xs with
  | 0,xs => x :: xs
  | S i',y :: xs => y :: insert2 i' x xs
  | S i',[] => [x]
  end.

Section disjoint.

Context `{Countable K}.

Context {V : Type}.

Definition disjoint (xs : list (gmap K V)) :=
    forall i j h1 h2,
        xs !! i = Some h1 -> xs !! j = Some h2 -> i ≠ j -> h1 ##ₘ h2.

End disjoint.

Definition fin_list {A} n (f : fin n -> A) : list A := vec_to_list (fun_to_vec f).

Definition fin_gset `{Countable A} n (f : fin n -> A) : gset A
  := list_to_set (fin_list n f).

Definition all_fin n := fin_gset n id.

Definition big_union `{Countable A} : gset (gset A) -> gset A := set_fold (∪) ∅.

Definition fin_union `{Countable A} n (f : fin n -> gset A) : gset A :=
  big_union (fin_gset n f).

Fixpoint list_to_mapi' {A} (xs : list A) (n : nat) : gmap nat A :=
  match xs with
  | [] => ∅
  | x::r => <[ n := x ]> (list_to_mapi' r (S n))
  end.

Definition list_to_mapi {A} (xs : list A) := list_to_mapi' xs 0.

Definition fin_gmap {T} n : (fin n -> T) -> gmap nat T := list_to_mapi ∘ fin_list n.

Definition gmap_slice `{Countable K1, Countable K2} {A} (m : gmap (K1 * K2) A) (x : K1) : gmap K2 A :=
  default ∅ (map_curry (M1:=gmap K1) (M2:=gmap K2) m !! x).

Definition map_kmap `{∀ A, Insert K2 A (M2 A), ∀ A, Empty (M2 A),
    ∀ A, MapFold K1 A (M1 A)} {A} (f : K1 → K2) (m : M1 A) : M2 A :=
  list_to_map (fmap (prod_map f id) (map_to_list m)).

Definition gmap_unslice `{Countable K1, Countable K2} {A} (m : gmap K2 A) (x : K1) : gmap (K1 * K2) A :=
  map_kmap (λ y, (x,y)) m.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.

Local Open Scope string_scope.

Lemma all_end_bufs_typed (bs : sbufsT) (ss : gmap participant session_type) :
  (∀ q s, ss "'!! q = Some s → s = EndT) →
  (∀ q, buf_empty bs q) →
  dom bs = dom ss →
  sbufs_typed bs ss.
Proof.
  revert bs ss.
  cofix IH.
  intros bs ss Hall Hempty Hdom.
  constructor.
  - intros n p q ts rs i H.
    specialize (Hall _ _ H). discriminate.
  - intros bs'"' n p q t i ts rs H.
    specialize (Hall _ _ H). discriminate.
  - intros p Hp. split; [apply Hempty|].
    apply IH.
    + intros q s Hq. apply lookup_delete_Some in Hq. naive_solver.
    + intros q b Hq r buf Hr.
      apply lookup_delete_Some in Hq. destruct Hq as [_ Hq].
      eapply Hempty; eauto.
    + rewrite "'!dom_delete_L, Hdom. reflexivity.
  - destruct (decide (bs = ∅)) as [H|H]; [now left|right].
    destruct (map_choose bs H) as (q & b & Hq).
    assert (q ∈ dom bs) as Hqb by (apply elem_of_dom; eauto).
    rewrite Hdom in Hqb.
    apply elem_of_dom in Hqb as [s Hqs].
    rewrite (Hall _ _ Hqs) in Hqs.
    exists q, EndT. split; [exact Hqs|exact I].
  - exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma all_end_consistent_two : consistent 2 (λ _, EndT).
Proof.
  unfold consistent.
  change (sbufs_typed
    (<[0 := <[0 := []]> (<[1 := []]> ∅)]>
      (<[1 := <[0 := []]> (<[1 := []]> ∅)]> ∅))
    (<[0 := EndT]> (<[1 := EndT]> ∅))).
  apply all_end_bufs_typed.
  - intros q s H.
    repeat rewrite lookup_insert_Some in H.
    rewrite lookup_empty in H. naive_solver.
  - intros q bs Hq p buf Hp.
    repeat rewrite lookup_insert_Some in Hq.
    rewrite lookup_empty in Hq.
    destruct Hq as [[_ <-]|[_ [[_ <-]|[_ Hbad]]]]; try discriminate.

    all: rewrite lookup_empty in Hp; naive_solver.

Qed.

Definition sole_worker := Lam "x" (Close (Var "x")).

Definition sole_program := Close (Spawn 1 sole_workers).

Lemma sole_program_typed : typed ∅ sole_program UnitT.
Proof.

  apply Close_typed.

  - exact all_end_consistent_two.
  - constructor.
    + intros p q _ x t1 t2 H. rewrite lookup_empty in H. discriminate.
    + intros p x t H. exact H.
    + intros x t H. exists 0%fin. exact H.
  - intros p. unfold sole_workers, sole_worker. constructor.
    + apply lookup_empty.
    + constructor. apply Var_typed.

Lemma end_sessions_compatible (bs : sbufsT) (ss : gmap participant session_type) :
  (∀ q s, ss "'!! q = Some s → s = EndT) →
  (∀ q, buf_empty bs q) →
  dom bs = dom ss →
  sbufs_typed bs ss.
Proof.
  revert bs ss.
  cofix IH.
  intros bs ss Hall Hempty Hdom.
  constructor.
  - intros n p q ts rs i H.
    specialize (Hall _ _ H). discriminate.
  - intros bs'"' n p q t i ts rs H.
    specialize (Hall _ _ H). discriminate.
  - intros p Hp. split; [apply Hempty|].
    apply IH.
    + intros q s Hq. apply lookup_delete_Some in Hq. naive_solver.
    + intros q b Hq r buf Hr.
      apply lookup_delete_Some in Hq. destruct Hq as [_ Hq].
      eapply Hempty; eauto.
    + unfold sbufsT in *. now rewrite "'!dom_delete_L, Hdom.
  - destruct (decide (bs = ∅)) as [H|H]; [now left|right].
    destruct (map_choose bs H) as (q & b & Hq).
    assert (q ∈ dom bs) as Hqb by (apply elem_of_dom; eauto).
    rewrite Hdom in Hqb.
    apply elem_of_dom in Hqb as [s Hqs].
    rewrite (Hall _ _ Hqs) in Hqs.
    exists q, EndT. exact (conj Hqs I).
  - exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma two_end_sessions_consistent : consistent 2 (λ _, EndT).
Proof.
  unfold consistent.
  change (sbufs_typed
    (<[0 := <[0 := []]> (<[1 := []]> ∅)]>
      (<[1 := <[0 := []]> (<[1 := []]> ∅)]> ∅))
    (<[0 := EndT]> (<[1 := EndT]> ∅))).
  apply end_sessions_compatible.
  - intros q s H.
    repeat rewrite lookup_insert_Some in H.
    rewrite lookup_empty in H. naive_solver.
  - intros q bs Hq p buf Hp.
    repeat rewrite lookup_insert_Some in Hq.
    rewrite lookup_empty in Hq.
    destruct Hq as [[_ <-]|[_ [[_ <-]|[_ Hbad]]]]; try discriminate.
    all: repeat rewrite lookup_insert_Some in Hp.
    all: rewrite lookup_empty in Hp; naive_solver.
  - now rewrite !dom_insert_L, !dom_empty_L.
Qed.

Definition worker := Lam "x" (Close (Var "x")).
Definition workers : fin 1 → expr := λ _, worker.
Definition program := Close (Spawn 1 workers).

Lemma program_typed : typed ∅ program UnitT.
Proof.
  unfold program.
  apply Close_typed.
  eapply (Spawn_typed 1 ∅ (λ _, ∅) workers (λ _, EndT)).
  - exact two_end_sessions_consistent.
  - constructor.
    + intros p q _ x t1 t2 H. rewrite lookup_empty in H. discriminate.
    + intros p x t H. exact H.
    + intros x t H. exists 0%fin. exact H.
  - intros p. unfold workers, worker. constructor.
    + apply lookup_empty.
    + constructor. apply Var_typed.

      * intros x t H. rewrite lookup_empty in H. discriminate.
      * constructor. constructor.
Qed.

Definition patch (f : fin 1 → expr) : fin 1 → expr :=
  λ q, if decide (0%fin = q) then worker else f q.

Lemma singleton_fin (q : fin 1) : q = 0%fin.
Proof.
  apply (fin_S_inv (λ p : fin 1, p = 0%fin)); [reflexivity|].
  intros z. exact (fin_0_inv (λ r, FS r = 0%fin) z).
Qed.

Lemma patch_agrees (f : fin 1 → expr) (q : fin 1) :
  workers q = patch f q.
Proof. now rewrite (singleton_fin q). Qed.

Lemma spawn_context_requires_patch k e :
  ctx1 k → k e = Spawn 1 workers → ∃ f, workers = patch f.
Proof.
  intros H Hshape. destruct H; simpl in Hshape; try discriminate.
  assert (n = 1) as -> by now injection Hshape.
  rewrite (singleton_fin p) in Hshape.
  injection Hshape as Hfn.
  apply (inj_pair2_eq_dec nat Nat.eq_dec) in Hfn.

Proof.

    specialize (H7 0%fin). discriminate.

From stdpp Require Export gmap.

Require Export cgraphs.multiparty.langdef.

Inductive object := Thread (_:nat) | Chan (_:session).

Definition object_code (x : object) : (nat + nat)%type :=
  match x with Thread n => inl n | Chan n => inr n end.

Definition object_decode (c : (nat + nat)%type) : object :=
  match c with inl n => Thread n | inr n => Chan n end.

Definition object_roundtrip (x : object) : object_decode (object_code x) = x :=
  match x with Thread _ => eq_refl | Chan _ => eq_refl end.

#[export] Instance object_eqdecision : EqDecision object :=
  fun x y =>
    match decide (object_code x = object_code y) with
    | left h =>
        left (eq_trans (eq_sym (object_roundtrip x))
          (eq_trans (f_equal object_decode h) (object_roundtrip y)))
    | right h => right (fun p => h (f_equal object_code p))
    end.

#[export] Instance object_countable : Countable object :=
  inj_countable' object_code object_decode object_roundtrip.

Fixpoint expr_refs (e : expr) : gset object :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_refs v
  | Var x => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Inj b e1 => expr_refs e1
  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | UApp e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Lam s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | ULam s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | Send p e1 i e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Recv p e1 => expr_refs e1
  | Let s e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetUnit e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetProd s1 s2 e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | MatchVoid e1 => expr_refs e1
  | MatchSum e1 s e2 e3 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2 ∪ expr_refs e3
  | InjN i e => expr_refs e
  | MatchSumN n e f => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ f)
  | If e1 e2 e3 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Spawn n f => fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ f)

with val_refs (v : val) : gset object :=

  | InjNV i v1 => val_refs v1
  | FunV s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | UFunV s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | ChanV (c,b) _ => {[ Chan c ]}
  end.

Definition map_union `{Countable K, Countable A} {V} (f : V -> gset A) (m : gmap K V) :=

Definition buf_refs (buf : list entryT) := foldr (λ '(i,v) s, val_refs v ∪ s) ∅ buf.

Definition bufs_refs (bufss : bufsT participant participant entryT) : gset object :=
  map_union (map_union buf_refs) bufss.

Definition obj_refs (es : list expr) (h : heap) (x : object) : gset object :=
  match x with
  | Thread n => from_option expr_refs ∅ (es !! n)
  | Chan c => bufs_refs (gmap_slice h c)

Definition thread_blocked (es : list expr) (h : heap) (i c : nat) :=
  ∃ p q k π, ctx k ∧
    es !! i = Some (k (Recv p (Val (ChanV (c,q) π)))) ∧
    is_Some (h !! (c,q)) ∧

  | Chan i => ∃ p, is_Some (h !! (i,p))
  end.

Record deadlock (es : list expr) (h : heap) (s : gset object) := {
  dl_nonempty : s ≠ ∅;
  dl_active x : x ∈ s -> active es h x;
  dl_threadb i : Thread i ∈ s -> ¬ can_stepi i es h;
  dl_threadw i c : Thread i ∈ s -> thread_blocked es h i c -> Chan c ∈ s;
  dl_chan c x : Chan c ∈ s -> Chan c ∈ obj_refs es h x -> x ∈ s

Definition deadlock_free es h := ∀ s, ¬ deadlock es h s.

Definition fully_reachable es h := ∀ x, active es h x -> reachable es h x.
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Pair_step : ∀ v1 v2,
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val (PairV v1 v2))
  | Inj_step : ∀ v1 b,
    pure_step (Inj b (Val v1)) (Val (InjV b v1))
  | App_step : ∀ x e a,
    pure_step (App (Val (FunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | UApp_step : ∀ x e a,
    pure_step (UApp (Val (UFunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Lam_step : ∀ x e,
    pure_step (Lam x e) (Val (FunV x e))
  | ULam_step : ∀ x e,
    pure_step (ULam x e) (Val (UFunV x e))
  | If_step1 : ∀ n e1 e2,

    pure_step (If (Val (NatV n)) e1 e2) e1
  | If_step2 : ∀ e1 e2,
    pure_step (If (Val (NatV 0)) e1 e2) e2
  | MatchSum_step : ∀ x v eL eR b,

  | InjN_step : ∀ n v,
    pure_step (InjN n (Val v)) (Val (InjNV n v))
  | MatchSumN_step : ∀ n i v f,
    pure_step (MatchSumN n (Val (InjNV (fin_to_nat i) v)) f) (App (f i) (Val v))
  | Let_step : ∀ x v e,
    pure_step (Let x (Val v) e) (subst x v e)
  | LetUnit_step : ∀ e,
    pure_step (LetUnit (Val UnitV) e) e
  | LetProd_step : ∀ x1 x2 v1 v2 e,
    pure_step (LetProd x1 x2 (Val (PairV v1 v2)) e) (subst x1 v1 $ subst x2 v2 e)
  | Relabel_step : ∀ π1 π2 c p,
    pure_step (Relabel π1 (Val (ChanV (c,p) π2))) (Val (ChanV (c,p) (π2 ∘ π1))).

Definition entryT := (nat * val)%type.

Notation bufsT A B V := (gmap B (gmap A (list V))).

Definition heap := bufsT participant endpoint entryT.

Definition push `{Countable A, Countable B} {V} (p : A) (q : B) (x : V) (bufss : bufsT A B V) : bufsT A B V :=
  alter (alter (λ buf, buf ++ [x]) p) q bufss.

Definition pop `{Countable A, Countable B} {V} (p : A) (q : B) (bufss : bufsT A B V) : option (V * bufsT A B V) :=
  match bufss !! q with
  | Some bufs =>
    match bufs !! p with
    | Some (v :: buf) => Some (v, <[ q := <[ p := buf ]> bufs ]> bufss)
    | _ => None
    end
  | None => None
  end.

Definition init_chans {A} n : bufsT participant participant A :=
  fin_gmap n (λ i, fin_gmap n (λ j, [])).

Definition init_threads (c : session) (n : nat) (fv : fin n -> val) : list expr :=
  fin_list n (λ i, App (Val (fv i)) (Val (ChanV (c, S (fin_to_nat i)) id))).

Inductive head_step : expr -> heap -> expr -> heap -> list expr -> Prop :=
  | Pure_step : ∀ e e' h,
    pure_step e e' -> head_step e h e' h []
  | Send_step : ∀ h c p q y i π,


    head_step (Send q (Val (ChanV (c,p) π)) i (Val y)) h
          (Val (ChanV (c,p) π))
          (push p (c,π q) (i,y) h)
          []
  | Recv_step : ∀ h c p q i y h' π,
    pop (π p) (c,q) h = Some ((i,y), h') ->
    head_step (Recv p (Val (ChanV (c,q) π))) h
          (Val (InjNV i (PairV (ChanV (c,q) π) y)))
          h'
          []
  | Close_step : ∀ c p h π,
    head_step (Close (Val (ChanV (c,p) π))) h
          (Val UnitV)
          (delete (c,p) h)
          []
  | Spawn_step : ∀ (h : heap) c n f fv,
    (∀ p, h !! (c,p) = None) ->
    (∀ p, f p = Val (fv p)) ->
    head_step
      (Spawn n f) h
      (Val (ChanV (c, 0) id))
      (gmap_unslice (init_chans (S n)) c ∪ h)
      (init_threads c n fv).

Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
Arguments EndT {_}.

Global Instance finvec_equiv `{Equiv T} n : Equiv (fin n -> T) := λ f g, ∀ i, f i ≡ g i.

CoInductive session_type_equiv `{Equiv T} : Equiv (session_type' T) :=
  | cteq_EndT : EndT ≡ EndT
  | cteq_SendT n t1 t2 f1 f2 p : t1 ≡ t2 -> f1 ≡ f2 -> SendT n p t1 f1 ≡ SendT n p t2 f2
  | cteq_RecvT n t1 t2 f1 f2 p : t1 ≡ t2 -> f1 ≡ f2 -> RecvT n p t1 f1 ≡ RecvT n p t2 f2.

Global Existing Instance session_type_equiv.

Definition session_type_id {T} (s : session_type' T) : session_type' T :=
  match s with
  | SendT n p t s' => SendT n p t s'
  | RecvT n p t s' => RecvT n p t s'
  | EndT => EndT
  end.

CoInductive type :=
  | UnitT : type
  | VoidT : type
  | NatT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT : type -> type -> type
  | SumNT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
  | FunT : type -> type -> type
  | UFunT : type -> type -> type
  | ChanT : session_type' type -> type.

Definition type_id (t : type) :=
  match t with
  | UnitT => UnitT
  | VoidT => VoidT
  | NatT => NatT
  | PairT t1 t2 => PairT t1 t2
  | SumT t1 t2 => SumT t1 t2
  | SumNT n f => SumNT n f
  | FunT t1 t2 => FunT t1 t2
  | UFunT t1 t2 => UFunT t1 t2
  | ChanT s => ChanT s
  end.

CoInductive type_equiv : Equiv type :=
  | teq_UnitT : UnitT ≡ UnitT
  | teq_VoidT : VoidT ≡ VoidT
  | teq_NatT : NatT ≡ NatT
  | teq_PairT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> PairT t1 t1' ≡ PairT t2 t2'
  | teq_SumT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> SumT t1 t1' ≡ SumT t2 t2'
  | teq_SumNT n f1 f2 : f1 ≡ f2 -> SumNT n f1 ≡ SumNT n f2
  | teq_FunT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> FunT t1 t1' ≡ FunT t2 t2'
  | teq_UFunT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> UFunT t1 t1' ≡ UFunT t2 t2'
  | teq_ChanT s1 s2 : s1 ≡ s2 -> ChanT s1 ≡ ChanT s2.

Global Existing Instance type_equiv.

Notation session_type := (session_type' type).

CoFixpoint relabelT (π : participant -> participant) (σ : session_type) :=
  match σ with
  | SendT n p ts σs => SendT n (π p) ts (relabelT π ∘ σs)
  | RecvT n p ts σs => RecvT n (π p) ts (relabelT π ∘ σs)
  | EndT => EndT
  end.

Notation envT := (gmap string type).

CoInductive unrestricted : type -> Prop :=
  | Nat_unrestricted : unrestricted NatT
  | Unit_unrestricted : unrestricted UnitT
  | Void_unrestricted : unrestricted VoidT
  | UFun_unrestricted t1 t2 : unrestricted (UFunT t1 t2)
  | Pair_unrestricted t1 t2 :
    unrestricted t1 -> unrestricted t2 ->
    unrestricted (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unrestricted t1 t2 :
    unrestricted t1 -> unrestricted t2 ->
    unrestricted (SumT t1 t2)
  | SumN_unrestricted n f :
    (∀ i, unrestricted (f i)) -> unrestricted (SumNT n f).

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : envT) : Prop :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 ≡ t2 ∧ unrestricted t1.

Definition Γunrestricted (Γ : envT) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unrestricted t.

Record disj_union n (Γ : envT) (fΓ : fin n -> envT) : Prop := {
  du_disj p q : p ≠ q -> disj (fΓ p) (fΓ q);
  du_left p x t : (fΓ p) !! x ≡ Some t -> Γ !! x ≡ Some t;
  du_right x t : Γ !! x ≡ Some t -> ∃ p, (fΓ p) !! x ≡ Some t
}.

Definition sentryT := (nat * type)%type.

Definition sbufsT := bufsT participant participant sentryT.

Definition can_progress {A}
  (bufs : bufsT participant participant A)
  (σs : gmap participant session_type) := ∃ q σ,
    σs !! q = Some σ ∧
    match σ with
    | RecvT n p _ _ => ∃ y bufs', pop p q bufs = Some(y,bufs')
    | _ => True
    end.

Definition buf_empty (bufs : bufsT participant participant sentryT) (p : participant) :=
  ∀ bs, bufs !! p = Some bs ->
    ∀ q buf, bs !! q = Some buf -> buf = [].

Definition bufs_empty {A} (bufs : bufsT participant participant A) :=
  ∀ p q, pop p q bufs = None.

Definition is_present `{Countable A, Countable B} {V}
    p q (bufss : bufsT A B V) :=
  match bufss !! q with
  | Some bufs => match bufs !! p with Some _ => True | None => False end
  | None => False
  end.

CoInductive sbufs_typed
  (bufs : bufsT participant participant sentryT)
  (σs : gmap participant session_type) : Prop := {




  sbufs_typed_send
      (n : nat) (p q : participant) ts ss (i : fin n) :
    σs !! p = Some (SendT n q ts ss) ->
      is_present p q bufs ∧
      sbufs_typed (push p q (fin_to_nat i,ts i) bufs) (<[p:=ss i]> σs);




  sbufs_typed_recv
      (bufs' : bufsT participant participant sentryT)
      (n : nat) (p q : participant) t i ts ss :
    σs !! q = Some (RecvT n p ts ss) ->
    pop p q bufs = Some((i,t),bufs') ->
    ∃ i', i = fin_to_nat i' ∧ t = ts i' ∧
      sbufs_typed bufs' (<[ q := ss i' ]> σs);




  sbufs_typed_end p :
    σs !! p = Some EndT ->
      buf_empty bufs p ∧
      sbufs_typed (delete p bufs) (delete p σs);


  sbufs_typed_progress :
    bufs = ∅ ∨ can_progress bufs σs;


  sbufs_typed_dom :
    dom bufs = dom σs
}.

Definition consistent n (σs : fin n -> session_type) :=
  sbufs_typed (init_chans n) (fin_gmap n σs).

Inductive typed : envT -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    typed Γ (Val UnitV) UnitT
  | Nat_typed : ∀ Γ n,
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    typed Γ (Val (NatV n)) NatT
  | Var_typed : ∀ Γ x t t',
    Γ !! x = None ->
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    t ≡ t' ->
    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t ]}) (Var x) t'
  | Pair_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | App_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (App e1 e2) t2
  | UApp_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (UFunT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (UApp e1 e2) t2
  | Lam_typed : ∀ Γ x e t1 t2,
    Γ !! x = None ->
    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Lam x e) (FunT t1 t2)
  | ULam_typed : ∀ Γ x e t1 t2,
    Γ !! x = None ->
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e t2 ->
    typed Γ (ULam x e) (UFunT t1 t2)
  | Send_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 n t r p i,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (ChanT (SendT n p t r)) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (t i) ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Send p e1 (fin_to_nat i) e2) (ChanT (r i))
  | Recv_typed : ∀ Γ e n t r p,
    typed Γ e (ChanT (RecvT n p t r)) ->
    typed Γ (Recv p e) (SumNT n (λ i, PairT (ChanT (r i)) (t i)))
  | Let_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 x,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    Γ2 !! x = None ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e2 t2 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Let x e1 e2) t2
  | LetUnit_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 UnitT ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (LetUnit e1 e2) t
  | LetProd_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t11 t12 t2 x1 x2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    x1 ≠ x2 ->
    Γ2 !! x1 = None ->
    Γ2 !! x2 = None ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t11 t12) ->
    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x1 := t11 ]} ∪ {[ x2 := t12 ]}) e2 t2 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (LetProd x1 x2 e1 e2) t2
  | MatchVoid_typed : ∀ Γ e t,
    typed Γ e VoidT ->
    typed Γ (MatchVoid e) t
  | MatchSum_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 eL eR tL tR t x,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    Γ2 !! x = None ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (SumT tL tR) ->
    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x := tL ]}) eL t ->
    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x := tR ]}) eR t ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (MatchSum e1 x eL eR) t
  | InjN_typed : ∀ Γ n f i e,
    typed Γ e (f i) ->
    typed Γ (InjN (fin_to_nat i) e) (SumNT n f)
  | MatchSumN_typed : ∀ n Γ1 Γ2 t (f : fin n -> type) fc e,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> Γ2 = ∅) ->
    typed Γ1 e (SumNT n f) ->
    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (fc i) (FunT (f i) t)) ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (MatchSumN n e fc) t
  | If_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 e3 t,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 NatT ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
    typed Γ2 e3 t ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (If e1 e2 e3) t
  | Spawn_typed : ∀ n Γ (fΓ : fin n -> envT) (f : fin n -> expr) (σs : fin (S n) -> session_type),
    consistent (S n) σs ->
    disj_union n Γ fΓ ->
    (∀ p, typed (fΓ p) (f p) (FunT (ChanT (σs (FS p))) UnitT)) ->
    typed Γ (Spawn n f) (ChanT (σs 0%fin))
  | Close_typed : ∀ Γ e,
    typed Γ e (ChanT EndT) ->
    typed Γ (Close e) UnitT
  | Relabel_typed : ∀ Γ π e σ,
    typed Γ e (ChanT (relabelT π σ)) ->
    typed Γ (Relabel π e) (ChanT σ)
  | Iso_typed : ∀ Γ t t' e,
    t ≡ t' ->
    typed Γ e t ->
    typed Γ e t'.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Logic.Eqdep_dec.

(* This example explains why failed conversion alone is insufficient. *)
CoInductive stream := cons : nat -> stream -> stream.
CoFixpoint zeros : stream := cons 0 zeros.
Definition observe (s : stream) : stream := match s with cons n t => cons n t end.

Lemma observe_eq (s : stream) : s = observe s.
Proof. destruct s; reflexivity. Defined.

Definition zeros_eq : zeros = observe zeros := observe_eq zeros.
Fail Definition zeros_eq_refl : zeros = observe zeros := eq_refl.
Print Assumptions zeros_eq.

Lemma full_reachability_rules_out_deadlock es h :
  fully_reachable es h → deadlock_free es h.
Proof.
  intros Hfull s Hdl.
  assert (∀ x, reachable es h x → x ∉ s) as Hout.
  {
    intros x Hreach. induction Hreach as
      [i Hstep | i c Hreach IH Hblocked | c x Href Hreach IH].
    - intros Hi. exact (dl_threadb _ _ _ Hdl i Hi Hstep).
    - intros Hi. apply IH. exact (dl_threadw _ _ _ Hdl i c Hi Hblocked).
    - intros Hc. apply IH. exact (dl_chan _ _ _ Hdl c x Hc Href).
  }
  apply (dl_nonempty _ _ _ Hdl).
  apply set_eq. intros x. rewrite elem_of_empty. split; [|contradiction].
  intros Hx. apply (Hout x); [apply Hfull; eapply dl_active; eauto|exact Hx].
Qed.

Lemma end_only_compatible (bs : sbufsT) (ss : gmap participant session_type) :
  (∀ q s, ss "'!! q = Some s → s = EndT) →
  (∀ q, buf_empty bs q) →
  dom bs = dom ss →
  sbufs_typed bs ss.
Proof.
  revert bs ss. cofix IH.
  intros bs ss Hends Hempty Hdom. constructor.

item.text:
I proved that full reachability implies deadlock freedom and added the axiom-free lemma to [Task.v](/workspace/Task.v:5). The full reachability proof remains open, and `make` fails on the pending target.

I withdraw my earlier claim that the target is unprovable. The [Rocq diagnostic](/tmp/ReachabilityDiagnostic.v:158) verifies that full reachability for a closed, well-typed singleton `Spawn` requires an equality between its worker function and the function rebuilt by `Ctx_Spawn`. I verified pointwise agreement, but I have neither proved the required function equality axiom-free nor ruled out such a proof.
I’ll focus on the equality required by the singleton `Spawn` case and check whether Rocq’s local finite-index lemmas can prove it without new assumptions.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Logic.Eqdep_dec.

Definition worker_type := FunT (ChanT EndT) UnitT.

Lemma end_buffers_compatible (bs : sbufsT) (ss : gmap participant session_type) :
  (∀ q s, ss "'!! q = Some s → s = EndT) →
  (∀ q, buf_empty bs q) →
  dom bs = dom ss →
  sbufs_typed bs ss.
Proof.
  revert bs ss. cofix IH.
  intros bs ss Hends Hempty Hdom. constructor.
  - intros n p q ts rs i H.
    specialize (Hends _ _ H). discriminate.
  - intros bs'"' n p q t i ts rs H.
    specialize (Hends _ _ H). discriminate.
  - intros p Hp. split; [apply Hempty|].
    apply IH.
    + intros q s Hq. apply lookup_delete_Some in Hq. naive_solver.
    + intros q b Hq r buf Hr. apply lookup_delete_Some in Hq as [_ Hq].
      eapply Hempty; eauto.
    + unfold sbufsT in *. now rewrite "'!dom_delete_L, Hdom.
  - destruct (decide (bs = ∅)) as [H|H]; [now left|right].
    destruct (map_choose bs H) as (q & b & Hq).
    assert (q ∈ dom bs) as Hqb by (apply elem_of_dom; eauto).
    rewrite Hdom in Hqb. apply elem_of_dom in Hqb as [s Hqs].
    rewrite (Hends _ _ Hqs) in Hqs. exists q, EndT. exact (conj Hqs I).
  - exact Hdom.
Qed.

Lemma two_ends_consistent : consistent 2 (λ _, EndT).
Proof.
  unfold consistent.
  change (sbufs_typed
    (<[0 := <[0 := []]> (<[1 := []]> ∅)]>
      (<[1 := <[0 := []]> (<[1 := []]> ∅)]> ∅))
    (<[0 := EndT]> (<[1 := EndT]> ∅))).
  apply end_buffers_compatible.
  - intros q s H. repeat rewrite lookup_insert_Some in H.
    rewrite lookup_empty in H. naive_solver.
  - intros q bs Hq p buf Hp. repeat rewrite lookup_insert_Some in Hq.
    rewrite lookup_empty in Hq.
    destruct Hq as [[_ <-]|[_ [[_ <-]|[_ Hbad]]]]; try discriminate.
    all: repeat rewrite lookup_insert_Some in Hp.
    all: rewrite lookup_empty in Hp; naive_solver.
  - now rewrite !dom_insert_L, !dom_empty_L.
Qed.

Definition singleton_program (f : fin 1 → expr) := Close (Spawn 1 f).
Definition singleton_patch (f fallback : fin 1 → expr) : fin 1 → expr :=
  λ q, if decide (0%fin = q) then f 0%fin else fallback q.

Lemma singleton_program_typed f :
  (∀ p, typed ∅ (f p) worker_type) → typed ∅ (singleton_program f) UnitT.
Proof.
  intros Hf. apply Close_typed.
  eapply (Spawn_typed 1 ∅ (λ _, ∅) f (λ _, EndT)); [apply two_ends_consistent| |exact Hf].
  constructor.
  - intros p q _ x t1 t2 H. rewrite lookup_empty in H. discriminate.
  - intros p x t H. exact H.
  - intros x t H. exists 0%fin. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma only_fin_one (q : fin 1) : q = 0%fin.
Proof.
  apply (fin_S_inv (λ p : fin 1, p = 0%fin)); [reflexivity|].
  intros z. exact (fin_0_inv (λ r, FS r = 0%fin) z).
Qed.

Lemma singleton_shell k e f :
  ctx1 k → k e = Spawn 1 f → ∃ fallback, f = singleton_patch f fallback.
Proof.
  intros Hk Hshape. destruct Hk; simpl in Hshape; try discriminate.
  assert (n = 1) as -> by now injection Hshape.
  rewrite (only_fin_one p) in Hshape.
  injection Hshape as Hfn. apply (inj_pair2_eq_dec nat Nat.eq_dec) in Hfn.
  assert (e = f 0%fin) as He.
  { exact (f_equal (λ g : fin 1 → expr, g 0%fin) Hfn). }
  exists f0. now unfold singleton_patch; rewrite <- He.
Qed.

Lemma step_at_spawn_needs_patch f k e h e'"' h' ts :
  (∀ v, f 0%fin ≠ Val v) →
  ctx k → head_step e h e' h' ts → k e = Spawn 1 f →
  ∃ fallback, f = singleton_patch f fallback.
Proof.
  intros Hnv Hk Hhead Hshape. destruct Hk as [|k1 k2 Hk1 Hk2].
  - simpl in Hshape. subst e. inversion Hhead; subst.
    + inversion H.
    + match goal with
      | Heq : existT 1 ?g = existT 1 f |- _ =>
        apply (inj_pair2_eq_dec nat Nat.eq_dec) in Heq; subst g
      end.
      match goal with Hvals : ∀ p, f p = Val _ |- _ =>
        exact (False_rect _ (Hnv _ (Hvals 0%fin)))
      end.
  - simpl in Hshape. eapply singleton_shell; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma context_step_at_program_needs_patch f h e' h' ts :
  (∀ v, f 0%fin ≠ Val v) →
  ctx_step (singleton_program f) h e' h' ts →
  ∃ fallback, f = singleton_patch f fallback.
Proof.
  intros Hnv Hstep. inversion Hstep as [k e ? ? ? ? Hk Hhead Hshape]; subst.
  destruct Hk as [|k1 k2 Hk1 Hk2].
  - simpl in Hshape. subst e. unfold singleton_program in Hhead.
    inversion Hhead; subst. inversion H.
  - unfold singleton_program in Hshape. destruct Hk1; simpl in Hshape; try discriminate.
    injection Hshape as Hinner. eapply step_at_spawn_needs_patch; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma singleton_step_needs_patch f :
  (∀ v, f 0%fin ≠ Val v) → can_stepi 0 [singleton_program f] ∅ →
  ∃ fallback, f = singleton_patch f fallback.
Proof.
  intros Hnv (es' & h' & Hstep). inversion Hstep; subst.
  assert (e = singleton_program f) as -> by naive_solver.
  eapply context_step_at_program_needs_patch; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma empty_heap_cannot_block es i c : ¬ thread_blocked es ∅ i c.
Proof.
  intros (p & q & k & pi & Hk & Hlook & [b Hb] & Hpop).
  change ((∅ : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) "'!! (c,q) = Some b) in Hb.
  rewrite lookup_empty in Hb. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma target_implies_singleton_patch :
  (∀ e es h, typed ∅ e UnitT → steps [e] ∅ es h →
    deadlock_free es h ∧ fully_reachable es h) →
  ∀ f : fin 1 → expr,
    (∀ p, typed ∅ (f p) worker_type) →
    (∀ v, f 0%fin ≠ Val v) →
    ∃ fallback, f = singleton_patch f fallback.
Proof.
  intros Htarget f Htyped Hnv.
  pose proof (singleton_program_typed f Htyped) as Hprogram.
  destruct (Htarget _ _ _ Hprogram (Empty_step _ _)) as [_ Hfull].
  assert (reachable [singleton_program f] ∅ (Thread 0)) as Hreach.
  { apply Hfull. exists (singleton_program f). split; [reflexivity|discriminate]. }
  inversion Hreach; subst.
  - eapply singleton_step_needs_patch; eauto.
  - exfalso. eapply empty_heap_cannot_block; eauto.
Qed.

Local Open Scope string_scope.
Definition worker := Lam "x" (Close (Var "x")).
Definition workers : fin 1 → expr := λ _, worker.

Lemma worker_typed : typed ∅ worker worker_type.
Proof.
  unfold worker, worker_type. constructor.
  - apply lookup_empty.
  - constructor. apply Var_typed.
    + apply lookup_empty.
    + intros x t H. rewrite lookup_empty in H. discriminate.
    + constructor. constructor.
Qed.

Lemma concrete_obligation :
  (∀ e es h, typed ∅ e UnitT → steps [e] ∅ es h →
    deadlock_free es h ∧ fully_reachable es h) →
  ∃ fallback, workers = singleton_patch workers fallback.
Proof.
  intro Htarget. apply target_implies_singleton_patch; try exact Htarget.
  - intros p. apply worker_typed.
  - discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma singleton_patch_pointwise f fallback q : f q = singleton_patch f fallback q.
Proof. now rewrite (only_fin_one q). Qed.

Fail Definition worker_patch_reflexivity fallback :
  workers = singleton_patch workers fallback := eq_refl.

Print Assumptions target_implies_singleton_patch.
Print Assumptions concrete_obligation.
EOF

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import definitions.

Lemma elem_of_fin_list_iff {A} n (f : fin n → A) (x : A) :
  x ∈ fin_list n f ↔ ∃ i, x = f i.
Proof.
  revert f.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros f.
  - change (x ∈ [] ↔ ∃ i : fin 0, x = f i).
    split.
    + rewrite elem_of_nil. contradiction.
    + intros [i _]. exact (fin_0_inv (λ _, x ∈ []) i).
  - change (x ∈ f 0%fin :: fin_list n (f ∘ FS) ↔ ∃ i, x = f i).
    rewrite elem_of_cons, IH. split.
    + intros [Hx|(i & Hx)].
      * now exists 0%fin.
      * now exists (FS i).
    + intros (i & Hi). revert Hi.
      apply (fin_S_inv (λ i, x = f i →
        x = f 0%fin ∨ (∃ j : fin n, x = (f ∘ FS) j))).
      * now left.
      * intros j Hj. right. now exists j.
Qed.

Lemma elem_of_big_union_iff (ss : gset (gset object)) x :
  x ∈ big_union ss ↔ ∃ s, s ∈ ss ∧ x ∈ s.
Proof.
  unfold big_union.
  refine (set_fold_ind
    (λ (r : gset object) (X : gset (gset object)), x ∈ r ↔ ∃ s, s ∈ X ∧ x ∈ s)
    (∪) ∅ _ _ _ ss).
  - intros r X Y HXY Hr. rewrite <- HXY. exact Hr.
  - set_solver.
  - intros s X r Hnot IH. rewrite elem_of_union, IH. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma elem_of_fin_union_iff n (f : fin n → gset object) x :
  x ∈ fin_union n f ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ f i.
Proof.
  unfold fin_union, fin_gset. rewrite elem_of_big_union_iff.
  split.
  - intros (s & Hs & Hx).
    apply elem_of_list_to_set, elem_of_fin_list_iff in Hs.
    destruct Hs as (i & ->). now exists i.
  - intros (i & Hi). exists (f i). split; [|exact Hi].
    apply elem_of_list_to_set, elem_of_fin_list_iff. now exists i.
Qed.

Lemma ctx1_reference_split k e :
  ctx1 k → expr_refs (k e) = expr_refs e ∪ expr_refs (k (Val UnitV)).
Proof.
  intros Hctx. destruct Hctx; cbn [expr_refs val_refs]; try set_solver.
  apply set_eq. intros x.
  rewrite elem_of_union. rewrite "'!elem_of_fin_union_iff.
  split.
  - intros (q & Hq). cbn [compose] in Hq.
    destruct (decide (p = q)) as [Heq|Hne].
    + now left.
    + right. exists q. cbn [compose]. now rewrite decide_False by exact Hne.
  - intros [He|(q & Hq)].
    + exists p. cbn [compose]. now rewrite decide_True by reflexivity.
    + cbn [compose] in Hq.
      destruct (decide (p = q)) as [Heq|Hne].
      * simpl in Hq. set_solver.
      * exists q. cbn [compose]. now rewrite decide_False by exact Hne.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_reference_split k e :
  ctx k → expr_refs (k e) = expr_refs e ∪ expr_refs (k (Val UnitV)).
Proof.
  intros Hctx. induction Hctx as [|k1 k2 H1 H2 IH].
  - simpl. set_solver.
  - rewrite (ctx1_reference_split k1 (k2 e) H1), IH.
    rewrite (ctx1_reference_split k1 (k2 (Val UnitV)) H1).
    set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma blocked_thread_references_channel es h i c :
  thread_blocked es h i c → Chan c ∈ obj_refs es h (Thread i).
Proof.
  intros (p & q & k & π & Hk & Hlookup & _ & _).
  simpl [obj_refs]. rewrite Hlookup. simpl from_option.
  rewrite (ctx_reference_split _ _ Hk).
  apply elem_of_union_l. simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_cannot_create_value k e :
  ctx k → (∀ v, e ≠ Val v) → ∀ v, k e ≠ Val v.
Proof.
  intros Hctx Hnonval. induction Hctx as [|k1 k2 H1 H2 IH].
  - exact Hnonval.
  - intros v. destruct H1; discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma blocked_thread_and_channel_active es h i c :
  thread_blocked es h i c → active es h (Thread i) ∧ active es h (Chan c).
Proof.
  intros (p & q & k & π & Hk & Hlookup & Hpresent & Hpop). split.
  - exists (k (Recv p (Val (ChanV (c,q) π)))). split; [exact Hlookup|].
    apply (ctx_cannot_create_value _ _ Hk); discriminate.
  - now exists q.
Qed.

Print Assumptions ctx_reference_split.
Print Assumptions blocked_thread_references_channel.
Print Assumptions blocked_thread_and_channel_active.
EOF

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Export mutil.

From cgraphs.cgraphs Require Export util.

Definition session := nat.

Definition participant := nat.

Definition endpoint := (session * participant)%type.

Inductive val :=
  | UnitV : val
  | NatV : nat -> val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | InjV : bool -> val -> val
  | InjNV : nat -> val -> val
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UFunV : string -> expr -> val
  | ChanV : endpoint -> (participant -> participant) -> val

with expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Inj : bool -> expr -> expr
  | InjN : nat -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | UApp : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Lam : string -> expr -> expr
  | ULam : string -> expr -> expr
  | Send : participant -> expr -> nat -> expr -> expr
  | Recv : participant -> expr -> expr
  | Let : string -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetUnit : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetProd : string -> string -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | MatchVoid : expr -> expr
  | MatchSum : expr -> string -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSumN n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | If : expr -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | Spawn n : (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | Close : expr -> expr
  | Relabel : (participant -> participant) -> expr -> expr.

Fixpoint subst (x:string) (a:val) (e:expr) : expr :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => e
  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | App e1 e2 => App (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | Inj b e1 => Inj b (subst x a e1)
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | UApp e1 e2 => UApp (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | Lam x' e1 => if decide (x = x') then e else Lam x' (subst x a e1)
  | ULam x' e1 => if decide (x = x') then e else ULam x' (subst x a e1)
  | Send p e1 i e2 => Send p (subst x a e1) i (subst x a e2)
  | Recv p e1 => Recv p (subst x a e1)
  | Let x' e1 e2 => Let x' (subst x a e1) (if decide (x = x') then e2 else subst x a e2)
  | LetUnit e1 e2 => LetUnit (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | LetProd x' y' e1 e2 =>
    LetProd x' y' (subst x a e1) (if decide (x = x' ∨ x = y') then e2 else subst x a e2)
  | MatchVoid e1 => MatchVoid (subst x a e1)
  | MatchSum e1 x' eL eR =>
    MatchSum (subst x a e1) x'
    (if decide (x = x') then eL else subst x a eL)
    (if decide (x = x') then eR else subst x a eR)
  | InjN n e => InjN n (subst x a e)
  | MatchSumN n e f => MatchSumN n (subst x a e) (λ i, subst x a (f i))
  | If e1 e2 e3 => If (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2) (subst x a e3)
  | Spawn ps f => Spawn ps (λ p, subst x a (f p))
  | Close e1 => Close (subst x a e1)
  | Relabel π e1 => Relabel π (subst x a e1)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Pair_step : ∀ v1 v2,
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val (PairV v1 v2))
  | Inj_step : ∀ v1 b,
    pure_step (Inj b (Val v1)) (Val (InjV b v1))
  | App_step : ∀ x e a,
    pure_step (App (Val (FunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | UApp_step : ∀ x e a,
    pure_step (UApp (Val (UFunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Lam_step : ∀ x e,
    pure_step (Lam x e) (Val (FunV x e))
  | ULam_step : ∀ x e,
    pure_step (ULam x e) (Val (UFunV x e))
  | If_step1 : ∀ n e1 e2,
    n ≠ 0 ->
    pure_step (If (Val (NatV n)) e1 e2) e1
  | If_step2 : ∀ e1 e2,
    pure_step (If (Val (NatV 0)) e1 e2) e2
  | MatchSum_step : ∀ x v eL eR b,
    pure_step (MatchSum (Val (InjV b v)) x eL eR)
      (if b then subst x v eL else subst x v eR)
  | InjN_step : ∀ n v,
    pure_step (InjN n (Val v)) (Val (InjNV n v))
  | MatchSumN_step : ∀ n i v f,
    pure_step (MatchSumN n (Val (InjNV (fin_to_nat i) v)) f) (App (f i) (Val v))
  | Let_step : ∀ x v e,
    pure_step (Let x (Val v) e) (subst x v e)
  | LetUnit_step : ∀ e,

  | LetProd_step : ∀ x1 x2 v1 v2 e,

  | Relabel_step : ∀ π1 π2 c p,

Definition entryT := (nat * val)%type.

Lemma fin_union_reference_bounds n (f g : fin n → gset object) refs :
  (∀ i, f i ⊆ g i ∧ g i ⊆ f i ∪ refs) →
  fin_union n f ⊆ fin_union n g ∧ fin_union n g ⊆ fin_union n f ∪ refs.
Proof.

  - intros c Hc. apply elem_of_fin_union_iff in Hc as (i & Hci).

    apply elem_of_union in Hci as [Hci|Hci].
    + apply elem_of_union_l, elem_of_fin_union_iff. now exists i.
    + now apply elem_of_union_r.

Lemma subst_reference_bounds x a e :
  expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (subst x a e) ∧
  expr_refs (subst x a e) ⊆ expr_refs e ∪ val_refs a.
Proof.
  induction e; cbn [subst expr_refs]; repeat case_decide;
    cbn [expr_refs]; try set_solver.
  all: match goal with
  | H : ∀ i : fin ?n, expr_refs (?f i) ⊆ expr_refs (subst x a (?f i)) ∧ _ |- _ =>
      pose proof (fin_union_reference_bounds n (expr_refs ∘ f)
        (λ i, expr_refs (subst x a (f i))) (val_refs a) H) as Hbranches
  end.
  all: cbn [compose] in *; set_solver.

Lemma reference_subset_in_context k e e' :

  if decide (ep = ep' ∧ p = p')
  then (λ buf, buf ++ [entry]) <"'$> buffer_at h ep'"' p'
  else buffer_at h ep' p'.
Proof.
  unfold buffer_at, push.
  destruct (decide (ep = ep')) as [->|Hnep].
  - rewrite lookup_alter_eq.
    destruct (decide (p = p')) as [->|Hnp].
    + rewrite decide_True by auto.
      destruct ((h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) "'!! ep'"')
        as [bs|]; [apply lookup_alter_eq|reflexivity].
    + rewrite decide_False by tauto.
      destruct ((h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) "'!! ep'"')
        as [bs|]; [now apply lookup_alter_ne|reflexivity].
  - rewrite decide_False by tauto.
    now rewrite lookup_alter_ne.
Qed.

Lemma queued_entry_push_iff h p ep entry ep' p' other :
  queued_entry (push p ep entry h) ep' p' other ↔
  queued_entry h ep' p' other ∨
  (ep = ep' ∧ p = p' ∧ is_Some (buffer_at h ep p) ∧ other = entry).
Proof.
  unfold queued_entry. rewrite buffer_at_push.
  destruct (decide (ep = ep' ∧ p = p')) as [[-> ->]|Hne].
  - destruct (buffer_at h ep' p') as [buf|] eqn:Hbuf; cbn.
    + unfold is_Some. split.
      * intros (xs & Hxs & Hother). injection Hxs as <-.
        apply elem_of_app in Hother as [Hother|Hother].
        -- left. now exists buf.
        -- apply elem_of_list_singleton in Hother. right.
           split; [reflexivity|]. split; [reflexivity|]. split; eauto.
      * intros [(xs & Hxs & Hother)|(_ & _ & _ & ->)].
        -- injection Hxs as <-. exists (buf ++ [entry]). split; [reflexivity|].
           apply elem_of_app. now left.
        -- exists (buf ++ [entry]). split; [reflexivity|].
           apply elem_of_app. right. apply elem_of_list_singleton. reflexivity.
    + unfold is_Some. split.
      * intros (xs & Hbad & _). discriminate.
      * intros [(xs & Hbad & _)|(_ & _ & (xs & Hbad) & _)]; discriminate.
  - split; [now left|].
    intros [Hold|(Heq & Hp & _ & _)]; [exact Hold|].
    exfalso. exact (Hne (conj Heq Hp)).
Qed.

Lemma buffer_at_pop h p ep entry h' :
  pop p ep h = Some (entry,h') →
  ∃ tail,
    buffer_at h ep p = Some (entry :: tail) ∧
    ∀ ep' p', buffer_at h' ep' p' =
      if decide (ep = ep' ∧ p = p')
      then Some tail
      else buffer_at h ep' p'.
Proof.
  unfold pop.
  destruct ((h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) "'!! ep)
    as [bs|] eqn:Hbs; [|discriminate].
  destruct (bs !! p) as [[|head tail]|] eqn:Hinner; try discriminate.
  intros Hpop. inversion Hpop; subst entry h'"'.
  exists tail. unfold buffer_at. split.
  - now rewrite Hbs.
  - intros ep' p'. destruct (decide (ep = ep')) as [->|Hnep].
    + rewrite lookup_insert_eq, Hbs. simpl.
      destruct (decide (p = p')) as [->|Hnp].
      * rewrite decide_True by auto. apply lookup_insert_eq.
      * rewrite decide_False by tauto. now apply lookup_insert_ne.
    + rewrite decide_False by tauto. now rewrite lookup_insert_ne.
Qed.

Lemma queued_entry_pop_iff h p ep entry h' ep' p' other :
  pop p ep h = Some (entry,h') →

  queued_entry h' ep' p' other ∨ (ep = ep' ∧ p = p' ∧ other = entry).

      * right. auto.
      * left. now exists tail.
    + intros [(xs & Hxs & Hother)|(_ & _ & ->)].
      * injection Hxs as <-. exists (entry :: tail). split; [reflexivity|].
        apply elem_of_cons. now right.
      * exists (entry :: tail). split; [reflexivity|].
        apply elem_of_cons. now left.
  - split; [now left|].
    intros [Hold'|(Heq & Hp & _)]; [exact Hold'|].
    exfalso. exact (Hne (conj Heq Hp)).

Lemma channel_references_push es h c q p i v d x :
  x ∈ obj_refs es (push p (c,q) (i,v) h) (Chan d) ↔
  x ∈ obj_refs es h (Chan d) ∨
  (c = d ∧ is_Some (buffer_at h (c,q) p) ∧ x ∈ val_refs v).

  rewrite "'!elem_of_channel_references_iff. split.
  - intros (q'"' & p' & i' & v' & Hqueued & Hx).
    apply queued_entry_push_iff in Hqueued as [Hqueued| (Hep & Hp & Hbuf & He)].
    + left. now exists q', p', i', v'.
    + injection Hep as -> ->. injection He as -> ->.
      now right.
  - intros [(q' & p' & i' & v' & Hqueued & Hx)|(-> & Hbuf & Hx)].
    + exists q', p', i', v'. split; [|exact Hx].
      apply queued_entry_push_iff. now left.

    + exists q', p', i', v'. split; [|exact Hx].
      eapply queued_entry_pop_iff; [exact Hpop|now left].
    + exists q, p, i, v. split; [|exact Hx].
      eapply queued_entry_pop_iff; [exact Hpop|right; auto].

Lemma lookup_numbered_list {A} (xs : list A) base i :
  list_to_mapi' xs base "'!! (base + i) = xs !! i.
Proof.
  revert base i.
  induction xs as [|x xs IH]; intros base i.
  - cbn [list_to_mapi'"']. rewrite lookup_empty, lookup_nil. reflexivity.
  - destruct i as [|i].
    + replace (base + 0) with base by lia. simpl list_to_mapi'.
      rewrite lookup_insert_eq. reflexivity.
    + simpl list_to_mapi'. rewrite lookup_insert_ne by lia.
      replace (base + S i) with (S base + i) by lia. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_finite_map {A} n (f : fin n → A) i :
  fin_gmap n f "'!! i = fin_list n f !! i.
Proof. exact (lookup_numbered_list (fin_list n f) 0 i). Qed.

Lemma finite_list_constant {A} n (x : A) :
  fin_list n (λ _, x) = replicate n x.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; [reflexivity|].
  change (x :: fin_list n (λ _, x) = x :: replicate n x).
  now rewrite IH.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_finite_constant {A} n (x : A) i y :
  fin_gmap n (λ _, x) !! i = Some y ↔ y = x ∧ i < n.
Proof. now rewrite lookup_finite_map, finite_list_constant, lookup_replicate. Qed.

Lemma lookup_gmap_unslice_some {A} (m : gmap participant A) (c d : session) q v :
  gmap_unslice m c !! (d,q) = Some v ↔ d = c ∧ m !! q = Some v.
Proof.
  unfold gmap_unslice, map_kmap.
  assert (NoDup ((prod_map (λ p : participant, (c,p)) id <$> map_to_list m).*1))
    as Hkeys.
  {
    assert ((prod_map (λ p : participant, (c,p)) id <$> map_to_list m).*1 =
      (λ p, (c,p)) <$> (map_to_list m).*1) as Hkey_map.
    { rewrite !list_fmap_compose. reflexivity. }
    rewrite Hkey_map.
    apply NoDup_fmap_2; [intros p q'"' Heq; now injection Heq|].
    apply NoDup_fst_map_to_list.
  }
  rewrite <- elem_of_list_to_map by exact Hkeys.
  rewrite list_elem_of_fmap.
  split.
  - intros ([p v'] & Heq & Hp). simpl in Heq.
    inversion Heq; subst. split; [reflexivity|].
    now apply elem_of_map_to_list.
  - intros (-> & Hlookup).
    exists (q,v). split; [reflexivity|].
    now apply elem_of_map_to_list.
Qed.

Lemma init_chans_empty_queue n q p (bs : gmap participant (list entryT)) buf :
  init_chans n "'!! q = Some bs →
  bs !! p = Some buf →
  buf = [].
Proof.
  unfold init_chans. intros Hbs Hp.
  apply lookup_finite_constant in Hbs as [-> _].
  now apply lookup_finite_constant in Hp as [-> _].
Qed.

Lemma allocation_preserves_queued_entries (h : heap) c n d q p entry :
  (∀ p, (h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) !! (c,p) = None) →
  queued_entry (gmap_unslice (init_chans n) c ∪ h) (d,q) p entry ↔
  queued_entry h (d,q) p entry.
Proof.
  intros Hfresh.
  set (new := gmap_unslice (init_chans n : bufsT participant participant entryT) c).
  unfold queued_entry, buffer_at.
  change ((∃ buf, ((new ∪ (h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT)))) !!
      (d,q) ≫= lookup p) = Some buf ∧ entry ∈ buf) ↔
    (∃ buf, ((h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) !!
      (d,q) ≫= lookup p) = Some buf ∧ entry ∈ buf)).
  rewrite lookup_union.
  destruct (new !! (d,q)) as [bs|] eqn:Hnew.
  - unfold new in Hnew. apply lookup_gmap_unslice_some in Hnew as [-> Hbs].
    rewrite Hfresh. simpl.
    split.
    + intros (buf & Hbuf & Hin).
      apply (init_chans_empty_queue n q p bs buf Hbs) in Hbuf. subst buf.
      apply elem_of_nil in Hin. contradiction.
    + intros (buf & Hbad & _). discriminate.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma allocation_preserves_heap_references es (h : heap) c n d x :
  (∀ p, (h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) !! (c,p) = None) →
  x ∈ obj_refs es (gmap_unslice (init_chans n) c ∪ h) (Chan d) ↔
  x ∈ obj_refs es h (Chan d).
Proof.
  intros Hfresh. rewrite !elem_of_channel_references_iff.
  setoid_rewrite (allocation_preserves_queued_entries h c n d _ _ _ Hfresh).
  reflexivity.
Qed.

  x ∈ thread_list_refs ts ↔ ∃ e, e ∈ ts ∧ x ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  induction ts as [|e ts IH]; cbn [thread_list_refs foldr].
  - rewrite elem_of_empty. split; [contradiction|].

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : envT) : Prop :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 ≡ t2 ∧ unrestricted t1.

Definition Γunrestricted (Γ : envT) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unrestricted t.

Record disj_union n (Γ : envT) (fΓ : fin n -> envT) : Prop := {
  du_disj p q : p ≠ q -> disj (fΓ p) (fΓ q);
  du_left p x t : (fΓ p) !! x ≡ Some t -> Γ !! x ≡ Some t;
  du_right x t : Γ !! x ≡ Some t -> ∃ p, (fΓ p) !! x ≡ Some t
}.

Definition sentryT := (nat * type)%type.

Definition sbufsT := bufsT participant participant sentryT.

Definition can_progress {A}
  (bufs : bufsT participant participant A)
  (σs : gmap participant session_type) := ∃ q σ,
    σs !! q = Some σ ∧
    match σ with
    | RecvT n p _ _ => ∃ y bufs', pop p q bufs = Some(y,bufs')
    | _ => True
    end.

Definition buf_empty (bufs : bufsT participant participant sentryT) (p : participant) :=
  ∀ bs, bufs !! p = Some bs ->
    ∀ q buf, bs !! q = Some buf -> buf = [].

Definition bufs_empty {A} (bufs : bufsT participant participant A) :=
  ∀ p q, pop p q bufs = None.

Definition is_present `{Countable A, Countable B} {V}
    p q (bufss : bufsT A B V) :=
  match bufss !! q with
  | Some bufs => match bufs !! p with Some _ => True | None => False end
  | None => False
  end.

CoInductive sbufs_typed
  (bufs : bufsT participant participant sentryT)
  (σs : gmap participant session_type) : Prop := {




  sbufs_typed_send
      (n : nat) (p q : participant) ts ss (i : fin n) :
    σs !! p = Some (SendT n q ts ss) ->
      is_present p q bufs ∧
      sbufs_typed (push p q (fin_to_nat i,ts i) bufs) (<[p:=ss i]> σs);




  sbufs_typed_recv
      (bufs' : bufsT participant participant sentryT)
      (n : nat) (p q : participant) t i ts ss :
    σs !! q = Some (RecvT n p ts ss) ->
    pop p q bufs = Some((i,t),bufs') ->
    ∃ i', i = fin_to_nat i' ∧ t = ts i' ∧
      sbufs_typed bufs' (<[ q := ss i' ]> σs);




  sbufs_typed_end p :
    σs !! p = Some EndT ->
      buf_empty bufs p ∧
      sbufs_typed (delete p bufs) (delete p σs);


  sbufs_typed_progress :
    bufs = ∅ ∨ can_progress bufs σs;


  sbufs_typed_dom :
    dom bufs = dom σs
}.

Definition consistent n (σs : fin n -> session_type) :=
  sbufs_typed (init_chans n) (fin_gmap n σs).

Lemma pop_queue_head_iff "'`{Countable Kp, Countable Kq} {A}
    (bufs : bufsT Kp Kq A) p q a :
  (∃ bufs'"', pop p q bufs = Some (a,bufs')) ↔
  (∃ tail, bufs "'!! q ≫= lookup p = Some (a :: tail)).
Proof.
  unfold pop.
  destruct (bufs !! q) as [bs|]; simpl.
  - destruct (bs !! p) as [[|head tail]|]; split; intros (out & Hout);
      try discriminate; inversion Hout; subst; eauto.
  - split; intros (out & Hout); discriminate.
Qed.

Definition typed_buffer_at (bufs : sbufsT) (q p : participant) : option (list sentryT) :=
  (bufs : gmap participant (gmap participant (list sentryT))) !! q ≫= lookup p.

Definition queued_entry_typed (value_typed : val → type → Prop)
    (entry : entryT) (type_entry : sentryT) : Prop :=
  entry.1 = type_entry.1 ∧ value_typed entry.2 type_entry.2.

Record session_queues_typed (value_typed : val → type → Prop)
    (h : heap) (c : session) (bufs : sbufsT) : Prop := {
  session_queues_domain q :
    is_Some ((bufs : gmap participant (gmap participant (list sentryT))) !! q) ↔
    is_Some ((h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) !! (c,q));
  session_queues_contents q p :
    option_Forall2 (Forall2 (queued_entry_typed value_typed))
      (buffer_at h (c,q) p) (typed_buffer_at bufs q p)
}.

Lemma typed_buffer_matching_concrete value_typed h c bufs q p entries :
  session_queues_typed value_typed h c bufs →
  buffer_at h (c,q) p = Some entries →
  ∃ tags, typed_buffer_at bufs q p = Some tags ∧
    Forall2 (queued_entry_typed value_typed) entries tags.
Proof.
  intros Htyped Hentry.
  pose proof (session_queues_contents _ _ _ _ Htyped q p) as Hqueues.
  rewrite Hentry in Hqueues. inversion Hqueues; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma concrete_buffer_matching_typed value_typed h c bufs q p tags :
  session_queues_typed value_typed h c bufs →
  typed_buffer_at bufs q p = Some tags →
  ∃ entries, buffer_at h (c,q) p = Some entries ∧
    Forall2 (queued_entry_typed value_typed) entries tags.
Proof.
  intros Htyped Htag.
  pose proof (session_queues_contents _ _ _ _ Htyped q p) as Hqueues.
  rewrite Htag in Hqueues. inversion Hqueues; subst. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma abstract_pop_has_concrete_match value_typed h c bufs p q i t bufs'"' :
  session_queues_typed value_typed h c bufs →
  pop p q bufs = Some ((i,t),bufs') →
  ∃ v h', pop p (c,q) h = Some ((i,v),h') ∧ value_typed v t.
Proof.
  intros Htyped Hpop.
  assert (∃ tags, typed_buffer_at bufs q p = Some ((i,t) :: tags)) as Hhead.
  { apply (proj1 (pop_queue_head_iff bufs p q (i,t))). now exists bufs'. }
  destruct Hhead as (tags & Hhead).
  destruct (concrete_buffer_matching_typed _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Htyped Hhead)
    as (entries & Hentries & Hmatch).
  apply Forall2_cons_inv_r in Hmatch as ([j v] & tail & [Hlabel Hv] & _ & ->).
  simpl in Hlabel. subst j.
  assert (∃ h', pop p (c,q) h = Some ((i,v),h')) as Hreal.
  { apply (proj2 (pop_queue_head_iff h p (c,q) (i,v))). now exists tail. }
  destruct Hreal as (h' & Hreal). now exists v, h'.
Qed.

  session_queues_typed value_typed h c bufs →
  pop p (c,q) h = Some ((i,v),h') →
  ∃ t bufs', pop p q bufs = Some ((i,t),bufs') ∧ value_typed v t.
Proof.
  intros Htyped Hpop.
  assert (∃ entries, buffer_at h (c,q) p = Some ((i,v) :: entries)) as Hhead.
  { apply (proj1 (pop_queue_head_iff h p (c,q) (i,v))). now exists h'. }
  destruct Hhead as (entries & Hhead).
  destruct (typed_buffer_matching_concrete _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Htyped Hhead)
    as (tags & Htags & Hmatch).
  apply Forall2_cons_inv_l in Hmatch as ([j t] & tail & [Hlabel Hv] & _ & ->).
  simpl in Hlabel. subst j.
  assert (∃ bufs', pop p q bufs = Some ((i,t),bufs')) as Habstract.
  { apply (proj2 (pop_queue_head_iff bufs p q (i,t))). now exists tail. }

Qed.

    n (ts : fin n → type) rs :
  session_queues_typed value_typed h c bufs →
  sbufs_typed bufs σs →
  σs "'!! q = Some (RecvT n p ts rs) →
  pop p (c,q) h = Some ((i,v),h'"') →
  ∃ (j : fin n) bufs',
    pop p q bufs = Some ((i,ts j),bufs') ∧
    i = fin_to_nat j ∧ value_typed v (ts j) ∧

    as (t & bufs' & Habstract & Hv).

    as (j & Hi & Ht & Hsafe').
  subst t. eauto 8.

  σs "'!! q = Some EndT →
  ∀ p entries, buffer_at h (c,q) p = Some entries → entries = [].
Proof.

    (σ : session_type) : Prop :=
  match σ with

Lemma active_session_has_ready_endpoint es h c value_typed bufs σs :
  active es h (Chan c) →

Lemma lookup_finite_constant_option {A} n (x : A) i :
  fin_gmap n (λ _, x) "'!! i = if decide (i < n) then Some x else None.
Proof.
  destruct (decide (i < n)) as [Hi|Hi].
  - apply lookup_finite_constant. now split.
  - destruct (fin_gmap n (λ _, x) !! i) as [v|] eqn:Hlook; [|reflexivity].
    apply lookup_finite_constant in Hlook as [_ Hlt]. contradiction.
Qed.

Lemma allocated_session_endpoint_lookup (h : heap) c n q :
  (∀ r, (h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) !! (c,r) = None) →
  (gmap_unslice (init_chans n : bufsT participant participant entryT) c ∪
    (h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT)))) !! ((c,q) : endpoint) =
  (init_chans n : bufsT participant participant entryT) !! q.
Proof.
  intros Hfresh.
  assert ((h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) !!
      ((c,q) : endpoint) = None) as Hnone by apply Hfresh.
  rewrite lookup_union, Hnone.
  destruct (gmap_unslice (init_chans n : bufsT participant participant entryT) c !!
    ((c,q) : endpoint)) as [bs|] eqn:Halloc.
  - apply lookup_gmap_unslice_some in Halloc as [_ Halloc].
    exact (eq_sym Halloc).
  - destruct ((init_chans n : bufsT participant participant entryT) !! q)
      as [bs|] eqn:Hinit; [|reflexivity].
    assert (gmap_unslice (init_chans n : bufsT participant participant entryT) c !!
      ((c,q) : endpoint) = Some bs) as Hbad.
    { apply lookup_gmap_unslice_some. now split. }
    congruence.
Qed.

Lemma initialized_session_queues_typed value_typed (h : heap) c n :
  (∀ q, (h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT))) !! (c,q) = None) →
  session_queues_typed value_typed
    (gmap_unslice (init_chans n : bufsT participant participant entryT) c ∪
      (h : gmap endpoint (gmap participant (list entryT)))) c
    (init_chans n).

  pose proof (λ q, allocated_session_endpoint_lookup h c n q Hfresh) as Halloc.

  - intros q. rewrite (Halloc q).
    change (is_Some (fin_gmap n (λ _, fin_gmap n (λ _, [] : list sentryT)) !! q) ↔

    rewrite !lookup_finite_constant_option.
    destruct (decide (q < n)); split; intros [bs Hbs]; try discriminate; eauto.
  - intros q p. unfold buffer_at, typed_buffer_at.
    rewrite (Halloc q).
    change (option_Forall2 (Forall2 (queued_entry_typed value_typed))
      (fin_gmap n (λ _, fin_gmap n (λ _, [] : list entryT)) !! q ≫= lookup p)
      (fin_gmap n (λ _, fin_gmap n (λ _, [] : list sentryT)) !! q ≫= lookup p)).
    rewrite !lookup_finite_constant_option.
    destruct (decide (q < n)); [|constructor].
    change (option_Forall2 (Forall2 (queued_entry_typed value_typed))
      (fin_gmap n (λ _, [] : list entryT) !! p)
      (fin_gmap n (λ _, [] : list sentryT) !! p)).
    rewrite !lookup_finite_constant_option.
    destruct (decide (p < n)); constructor; constructor.
Qed.

Lemma dependency_has_active_source es h x y :
  reachability_dependency es h x y → active es h x.
Proof.
  intros Hdependency. destruct Hdependency as [i c Hblocked|x c Hreference].
  - exact (proj2 (blocked_thread_and_channel_active _ _ _ _ Hblocked)).

Lemma full_reachability_from_acyclic_dependencies es h (R : object → object → Prop) :
  (∀ x, ¬ tc R x x) →
  (∀ x y, R x y → reachability_dependency es h x y) →
  (∀ x, active es h x →
    (∃ i, x = Thread i ∧ can_stepi i es h) ∨ (∃ y, R y x)) →
  fully_reachable es h.
Proof.
  intros Hacyclic Hedges Hprogress.
  assert (well_founded R) as Hwf.
  { eapply (finite_predecessors_acyclic_wf R (state_objects es h)).
    - intros x y Hxy. apply active_in_state_objects.
      eapply dependency_has_active_source. exact (Hedges x y Hxy).
    - exact Hacyclic. }
  intros x. induction (Hwf x) as [x Hpred IH]. intros Hactive.
  destruct (Hprogress x Hactive) as [(i & -> & Hstep)|(y & Hy)].
  - apply Thread_step_reachable. exact Hstep.
  - pose proof (Hedges y x Hy) as Hdep.
    pose proof (IH y Hy (dependency_has_active_source _ _ _ _ Hdep)) as Hreach.
    destruct Hdep; eauto using Thread_blocked_reachable, Chan_ref_reachable.
Qed.

Theorem deadlock_freedom_and_full_reachability e es h :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps [e] ∅ es h ->
  deadlock_free es h ∧ fully_reachable es h.

Definition ownership_edge (owns : object → endpoint → Prop)
    (ep : endpoint) (x y : object) : Prop :=
  (y = Chan (fst ep) ∧ owns x ep) ∨ (x = Chan (fst ep) ∧ owns y ep).

Inductive nonbacktracking_ownership_walk (edge : endpoint → object → object → Prop) :
    object → endpoint → object → Prop :=
  | Ownership_walk_single ep x y :
      edge ep x y → nonbacktracking_ownership_walk edge x ep y
  | Ownership_walk_extend ep next x y z :
      edge ep x y → ep ≠ next → nonbacktracking_ownership_walk edge y next z →
      nonbacktracking_ownership_walk edge x ep z.

Lemma dependency_walk_is_nonbacktracking (edge directed : endpoint → object → object → Prop) :
  (∀ ep x y, directed ep x y → edge ep x y) →
  (∀ ep x y z, directed ep x y → directed ep y z → False) →
  ∀ x y, tc (λ x y, ∃ ep, directed ep x y) x y →
    ∃ ep next, directed ep x next ∧ nonbacktracking_ownership_walk edge x ep y.
Proof.
  intros Hsub Hno_repeat x y Hpath.
  induction Hpath as [x y [ep Hxy]|x y z [ep Hxy] Hpath IH].

Lemma ownership_walk_mono (E F : endpoint → object → object → Prop) :
  (∀ ep x y, E ep x y → F ep x y) →

Definition contract_vertex (u v x : object) : object :=
  if decide (x = u) then v else x.

Definition contracted_ownership_edge (E : endpoint → object → object → Prop)
    (u v : object) (pivot ep : endpoint) (x y : object) : Prop :=
  ep ≠ pivot ∧ ∃ a b, E ep a b ∧
    contract_vertex u v a = x ∧ contract_vertex u v b = y.

Lemma contract_pivot_endpoints u v :
  contract_vertex u v u = contract_vertex u v v.
Proof.
  unfold contract_vertex. rewrite decide_True by reflexivity.
  destruct (decide (v = u)); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma contract_vertex_identifies_distinct u v x y :
  contract_vertex u v x = contract_vertex u v y →
  x ≠ y →
  (x = u ∧ y = v) ∨ (x = v ∧ y = u).
Proof.
  unfold contract_vertex.
  destruct (decide (x = u)), (decide (y = u)); intros Hxy Hne; subst;
    intuition congruence.
Qed.

Lemma pivot_connects_distinct_representatives E u v pivot x y :

  contract_vertex u v x = contract_vertex u v y → x ≠ y →
  E pivot x y.
